# Pixel Peeker

> LED wall layout, and what each port will carry

A browser tool for planning LED video walls: lay out the cabinets, add NovaStar or Brompton processors, wire up the ports, and see each port's load and headroom. The capacity model allows for the power-of-two packing the controllers actually use, so it matches the manufacturers' published per-port figures instead of promising more than a port will carry.

It's a Stoatworks Labs web tool: free, and it runs in a web browser.
